title: security: rbac v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Patel
body: Motivation: customers in regulated industries require deterministic data residency for keys and stronger audit trails when KMS keys are used to encrypt workloads. This PR hardens RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region pinning, improves audit logging for KMS residency decisions, and adds a migration path and rollout plan. Summary of changes: 1) Enforcement: add a new policy predicate `kms_region_pinning` that can be attached to resource scopes. When enabled, requests referencing customer-managed KMS keys are validated against the resource's pinned region. Policy enforcement happens at the admission layer and at runtime in the serving path to prevent cross-region key usage. 2) Audit logging: extend the audit schema to include `kms_key_location`, `kms_policy_match`, and `pinning_decision` fields. Logs emitted to the audit sink include whether enforcement was evaluated, reason codes, and fallback actions. 3) KMS integration: update the KMS adapter to surface key metadata (region, residency) and cache key residency with TTL and invalidation hooks when keys are re-wrapped. 4) Validation tools: add a policy linter and a CLI check `rctl validate-kms-pinning` to find resources that will fail enforcement before rollout. 5) Migration: include a migration that tags existing resources with inferred `kms_region` when possible and a safe-fail flag that converts enforcement from audit-only to deny mode after canary. 6) Tests: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests across the adapter and admission path, and e2e canary harness changes. Rollout plan: - Feature flag `rbac_v2_kms_pinning_enforce` defaults to false. - Phase 1 (audit-only): enable audit logs for 2 weeks, collect mismatches, notify customers with remediation instructions. - Phase 2 (soft-enforce for pilot tenants): enable deny mode for pilot accounts with opt-in. - Phase 3 (global enforcement): flip the feature flag after remediation window. Backwards compatibility: the policy predicate is additive and defaults to audit-only unless a tenant explicitly opts in. Runtime path only enforces compatibility between KMS key region metadata and pinned region values. Risk and mitigations: - False positives: mitigated by audit-only phase and CLI validation. - Performance: added cache with configurable TTL to avoid KMS metadata RPCs on hot paths. Observability: new metrics rbac.kms.pinning.evaluations_total, rbac.kms.pinning.denied_total, audit.kms.residency.mismatch_total. Docs: included a new doc under docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md with remediation steps and Linear/JIRA links. Checklist: - [x] Policy predicate implementation - [x] Audit log schema update and sink changes - [x] KMS adapter metadata and caching - [x] CLI validator and linter - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Migration script and canary harness - [x] Docs and release notes - [x] Security review Notes: this PR intentionally keeps behavior behind the feature flag; operators should coordinate with support to notify affected customers. See related Linear/SEC items for rollout cadence.

review_comments: Ethan Morales: Please add a timeout to the KMS metadata RPC and ensure the cache TTL is configurable — otherwise hot startup could OOM if KMS is slow.
Maya Patel (author): Added context timeout, configurable TTL via KMS_ADAPTER_CACHE_TTL, and unit tests for timeout behavior (commit b5c2d3f).
Sofia Ruiz: Audit schema change looks fine, but we need to ensure downstream audit sinks (SIEM) can handle new fields. Please coordinate with infra-logging team.
Maya Patel: Coordinated with infra-logging; added compatibility tests that emit legacy-compatible flattened fields when sinks declare `audit_v2=false`.
Liam Chen: Integration test flakes on CI (kms_residency_integration_test). Could be timing; please retry with increased retry/backoff.
Maya Patel: Increased retry/backoff and added deterministic fixture to stabilize the test (commit aa11bb0). CI passed on rerun.
ci_checks: integration-tests: initially failed (flaky kms_residency_integration_test) -> rerun passed
merge_outcome: merged via squash on 2026-03-01 by Sofia Ruiz (merge_commit: ffe3a9b7b6a1c0d2)
release_notes: Enforce optional KMS region pinning via RBAC v2 predicate; audit-only mode available behind feature flag. Added CLI validation to identify mismatched resources. Admins: run `rctl validate-kms-pinning` and follow docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md before enabling enforcement.
summary: Adds enforcement and audit logging hardening for KMS region pinning in RBAC v2, with migration tooling and feature-flagged rollout.
notes_to_ops: Before enabling enforcement, run migration script and `rctl validate-kms-pinning`. Monitor metrics rbac.kms.pinning.evaluations_total and audit.kms.residency.mismatch_total. Coordinate with infra-logging for sink compatibility.
